findings.summary: The header subtitle text sits inside a primaryContainer box but uses no explicit color, so it inherits the default onSurface color, which can lack contrast against the container in dark mode.
findings.fix: Give the subtitle (and ideally the title on line 99) an explicit color of Theme.of(context).colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer so it reads correctly against the primaryContainer background in both themes.

findings.summary: The meeting ListTile shows a trailing chevron_left_rounded (a navigation affordance) but has no onTap, implying an action that does not exist.
findings.fix: Either remove the trailing chevron since the row is not tappable, or add an onTap if a detail action exists; the chevron should not appear on a non-interactive tile.

findings.summary: The overdue progress-bar color is hardcoded as const Color(0xFFD98508) rather than pulled from the shared status palette source.
findings.fix: This amber matches the shared status palette so it is acceptable, but prefer deriving the overdue color from the same source used by MobileStatusPill (the 'pending'/'high' amber) instead of re-declaring the hex inline.

findings.summary: The header subtitle uses a bespoke TextStyle(fontSize: 12) instead of the theme's bodySmall used elsewhere (e.g. MobileSectionHeader subtitles).
findings.fix: Use Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall for the subtitle to match the typographic scale used by MobileSectionHeader and other pages.

findings.summary: The header container uses radius 24, its leading icon box 18, and the meeting date box 14, none matching the design-system card radius of 20.
findings.fix: Align the header container radius to 20 (the established card radius) and normalize the inner icon and date box radii toward the 16 input radius for consistency.

findings.summary: The loading state centers the spinner with a hardcoded SizedBox(height: 230) spacer, which is brittle across viewport heights.
findings.fix: Replace the fixed 230px spacer with a responsive centered layout (e.g. a min-height constrained Center) so the spinner stays centered across screen sizes.

findings.summary: The error state uses a plain 52px icon and no brand mark, making brand presence inconsistent on this full-page state.
findings.fix: Consider adding a BrandLogoMark above the error icon and message to keep brand presence consistent with other headered surfaces in the app.
